core_obligations: Identify the image of T as the stable open
Compute the Hilbert polynomial by Riemann-Roch
Apply the boundedness criterion with the tricanonical lemma
difficulty_reason: Quasi-compactness of the stable locus: T is defined as stable tricanonically polarized points, its image is exactly the stable open, and the boundedness criterion is applied with the Hilbert polynomial P(t) = (6g-6)t + (1-g) computed from Riemann-Roch on omega^3, with very ampleness and H^1 = 0 supplied by the tricanonical lemma. Retained author proof at lines 3508-3554.

compared.note: Quasi-compactness of the stable locus; distinct from lemma-stable-separated (separatedness).
